errors.what: First C draft laid each frame's row out as [whole, crops, zooms, fines], so the 49 fine-grid windows were not contiguous and fine lanes read zoom hashes
errors.caught_by: equality test against the all-pairs scan (101 extra pairs)

errors.what: Synthetic-burst tests let two seeded faults through (one crop direction dropped, fine gain off by one): their whole-frame distances sat under the near-duplicate line
errors.fixed: added a boundary test with lanes at and one past each limit above the near-duplicate line; 15 of 15 seeded faults now fail

doc_friction.issue: Running `python3 -m unittest tests.test_cull` from the venture directory fails with ModuleNotFoundError: shootflow; it needs PYTHONPATH=src (run_venture_tests.py sets it). One wasted run.

To get the timing corpus you must run the whole eval, whose all-pairs scoring runs single-threaded for many minutes after the frames are cut; only the frames are needed for tools/cull_group_timing.py. A --cut-only flag would save the wait (I killed it once the frames were written).

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
